method: Root reviewer evaluates actual learner_response and state_action against these predeclared semantic requirements. Automated checks are only envelope/coverage aids; keyword presence is not a semantic pass. A case passes only when every critical requirement passes. Closing a session may have zero questions; all teaching cases have one independently scorable action. This is model review, not human validation or production reliability estimation.
limitations: Same model family; two executors per round, six fixtures per executor. Single output per case per round; not human evaluation, deployed-plugin validation, or a reliability confidence estimate.
